as the internet was bustling with a plethora of courses to master these skills. I read few blogs on 'Medium' 
and 'TowardsDataScience' to get an overview of the domain. 
Later, I enrolled my self in 'Data Science A-Z' offered on udemy. This course gave me an entry-level 
understanding of data preprocessing(using notepad++ and excel), data modeling (NOT using any languages like Python or R), and data visualization(using Tableau).

Next, I enrolled myself in two other courses, 'Python A-Z for Data Science' and 'Machine Learning A-Z'on udemy.
I didn't complete any of these courses because of the following reasons
- I was unable to validate the application of the artifacts which I was learning
- I was unsure about the fact that whether this domain is for me(**Most important factor)
- I was unable to prioritize the study materials and got overwhelmed by the diversity of this domain
- I was unaware of the fact that 'Where to start?'
- How long will it take?

Currently, I am trying to figure out whether I should enter into this domain or not?</span></span><!----></p>

        <div id="ember85" class="feed-shared-update-v2__description-wrapper ember-view"><div id="ember86" class="feed-shared-inline-show-more-text feed-shared-update-v2__description feed-shared-inline-show-more-text--minimal-padding feed-shared-inline-show-more-text--5-lines feed-shared-inline-show-more-text--expanded ember-view" style="max-height: none; display: block;">      <div dir="ltr" id="ember87" class="feed-shared-text feed-shared-update-v2__commentary ember-view">  <div id="ember88" class="feed-shared-text__text-view feed-shared-text-view white-space-pre-wrap break-words ember-view"><span><span id="ember91" class="ember-view"><span>"Tell me the success of your students so far ?" was the question from some random person

Hence I decided to answer this to everyone. 

My I batch student </span></span><a target="_self" href="/in/ACoAACFpVt0B4uNHDuTVeSUINv_CcOe8tGt1ktQ/" id="ember95" class="tap-target feed-shared-text-view__mention ember-view"><span data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAACFpVt0B4uNHDuTVeSUINv_CcOe8tGt1ktQ" data-entity-type="MINI_PROFILE">Siddharth Singh</span></a><button class="entity-hovercard__a11y-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="See more about Siddharth Singh" data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAACFpVt0B4uNHDuTVeSUINv_CcOe8tGt1ktQ" data-entity-hovercard-trigger="click"></button><span id="ember99" class="ember-view"><span> didn't have great gpa but he wanted to land in good analytics program. After 1 year of mentoring , he made it one of best in US.

</span></span><a target="_self" href="/in/ACoAAAWguDQBsoZDmV-snO82mxSjKx_UOMK4PIk/" id="ember103" class="tap-target feed-shared-text-view__mention ember-view"><span data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAAAWguDQBsoZDmV-snO82mxSjKx_UOMK4PIk" data-entity-type="MINI_PROFILE">Aravind Muktheswaram</span></a><button class="entity-hovercard__a11y-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="See more about Aravind Muktheswaram" data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAAAWguDQBsoZDmV-snO82mxSjKx_UOMK4PIk" data-entity-hovercard-trigger="click"></button><span id="ember107" class="ember-view"><span> , a very senior person gave me opportunity to teach me. Today, he is one of best health care analytics professional in Hyderabad

A student from III batch , Mohamed Hantirah went on creating his own training academy in his country after I mentored him 1-1. 

</span></span><a target="_self" href="/in/ACoAACIHXt8BVIyLgkLzsXwy105GAJcDXjyn3ho/" id="ember111" class="tap-target feed-shared-text-view__mention ember-view"><span data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAACIHXt8BVIyLgkLzsXwy105GAJcDXjyn3ho" data-entity-type="MINI_PROFILE">Shravya Chillamcherla</span></a><button class="entity-hovercard__a11y-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="See more about Shravya Chillamcherla" data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAACIHXt8BVIyLgkLzsXwy105GAJcDXjyn3ho" data-entity-hovercard-trigger="click"></button><span id="ember115" class="ember-view"><span> from IV batch made it to prestigious IIT Hyderabad MDS program. Another student from IV batch </span></span><a target="_self" href="/in/ACoAABl58BMB20AIOJT9AakheLrJmHayrqC5fi8/" id="ember119" class="tap-target feed-shared-text-view__mention ember-view"><span data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAABl58BMB20AIOJT9AakheLrJmHayrqC5fi8" data-entity-type="MINI_PROFILE">Sachin Tripathi</span></a><button class="entity-hovercard__a11y-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="See more about Sachin Tripathi" data-entity-hovercard-id="urn:li:fs_miniProfile:ACoAABl58BMB20AIOJT9AakheLrJmHayrqC5fi8" data-entity-hovercard-trigger="click"></button><span id="ember123" class="ember-view"><span> started his own podcast AI pe Charcha. 

Whatever is the goal - MS, M Tech in Data Science , becoming a Data Scientist, AI Entrepreneur , AI trainers or AI for good, my students achieved every single goal.

End to End Data Science is NOT one size fits all course you see on Udemy or Coursera !!

I don't take credits for their hard work. But definitely without a solid course base and mentoring, it will be difficult to achieve. 

A good teacher teaches, 
   A better one informs, 
     And the best inspires.
